title: Pied Piper | Social Media Music App
achievements: Led a team of 7 as Backend Lead, integrating the Spotify API and utilizing AWS Personalize recommender engine for user matching.
Optimized MongoDB Atlas schemas and backend API queries, increasing maximum system throughput by 60% during peak loads.
Constructed a secure authentication system in Next.js using NextAuth and JWT for secure Spotify account linking.
Key Achievement: Achieved a 3x decrease in API query latency following database refactoring, validated via AWS CloudWatch metrics.

details.headline: Optimizing MongoDB for Real-Time Recommendations
details.problem: The initial architecture for the music recommendation feed suffered from severe latency issues. Queries against the MongoDB database were slow due to inefficient schema design and lack of indexing, resulting in a poor user experience and excessive load on the AWS infrastructure.
details.solution: As Backend Lead, I redesigned the MongoDB schema to optimize for read-heavy operations, utilizing denormalization and implementing strategic indexing on key fields. I integrated AWS Personalize for ML-driven recommendations and used AWS CloudWatch to monitor performance improvements.

impact.text: Increase in maximum system throughput during peak loads
Decrease in overall API query latency
